title: Send every summary within four hours, for one week
why_matters: The summary you send within four hours is qualitatively different from the one you send the next morning. Same-day writing is hot; you can still remember the texture of the disagreement. Next-day writing smooths over the moments that mattered. Make same-day your default.
steps: For every meeting this week where you're the senior BA in the room (or the only BA), commit to sending a summary within four hours.
Use the three-section structure: decided, open, next action + owner.
Note the time the meeting ended and the time you sent the summary. Track for the whole week.
At week's end, look at the summaries that took longest. Why? That's your week-6 improvement target.
success_criteria: Every meeting summary this week sent within four hours of the meeting ending. The tracking log shows the time-to-send per meeting. You can name the meeting type that took longest.
reflection_prompt: Which meeting was hardest to summarise within four hours, and what does that tell you about it?
